cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Sales & Account Manager (Digital Services) position. My background combines digital marketing, web development, and client-facing work, which gives me a practical understanding of the services you offer and the ability to communicate their value clearly to clients.

In my freelance work and my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage client projects from initial contact through delivery. I handle enquiries, coordinate timelines, and ensure that what was promised is what gets delivered. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing technical SEO and structured data, and I currently maintain a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profile pages. These projects required regular client communication, problem-solving, and close coordination with internal teams.

I'm comfortable with cold outreach and follow-ups, and I use Google Workspace and reporting tools daily for tracking and communication. While my sales experience is not in a dedicated sales role, I have consistently applied relationship management and client communication skills in my digital marketing work. I'm eager to bring this foundation to a structured sales environment and grow into the role.

I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium, and available to work the required schedule, including Saturdays and emergencies when needed. I'm confident that my mix of digital marketing knowledge, technical skills, and client-facing experience makes me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
